summary_md: **Alex ([@auroramaster](https://x.com/auroramaster/status/2116418421592383915))** built **mcp-restart**, a proxy that hot-swaps MCP servers in Claude Code desktop. It keeps the original connection, starts the new build, replays initialize and sends list_changed so new tools appear mid-session, and falls back to the old server if a build fails. He asks Anthropic for a native restart ([X-15/mcp-restart](https://github.com/X-15/mcp-restart)).
